world: precision instrument + field notebook. Amber (--signal) is a MARK only (ticks, edges, today ring, completed-set tick, needle) — never text and never a CTA fill. Amber TEXT uses --signal-ink. Data ticks/rules that encode information use --hairline-strong. All numbers are IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums slashed-zero. Continues M1: one SessionCard shell (header / title / target grid / meta line / action row) with bodies swapped by session.kind. M2 adds logging, completed state, calendar nav, and a units control WITHOUT changing that shell.

wires.screen: 1. Entry point — session card gains the LOG action (shape unchanged)

notes.intent: The only change to the existing card is the action row: it becomes a two-up footer, WHY on the left, LOG on the right (the M1 plan). Nothing else moves, so the card the user learned in M1 is the same object that now accepts a result.
tokens: ink-filled CTA on paper
hairline-strong rule above the footer
amber edge tick stays a mark, not a button tint
signal-ink only for the WHY text link
notes.motion: No new motion; LOG opens the run log sheet via the M1 sheet-rise.
notes.a11y: LOG RUN is the primary button, 48px. WHY THIS? is a text link with aria-expanded. Both >=44px and never colour-only.
notes.responsive: Footer stays two-up down to 320px; below that LOG goes full-width and WHY wraps above it.

notes.intent: A form that already knows the prescription. Distance and duration are the only required inputs; pace is derived and shown as a first-class readout, not a hidden field. HR, RPE and note are optional.
tokens: --sunken input wells on --paper sheet
ink 24px mono values in wells
steel 12px caps labels above fields
hairline-strong between blocks
amber mark only on the active unit segment and the selected RPE cell
components: NumberField (18px input text, unit inside well, inputmode=decimal)
notes.motion: sheet-rise (M1). The derived pace swaps instantly on each valid keystroke — never counts up (numerals anti-rule).
notes.a11y: Labels above fields permanently (no placeholder labels); unit is part of the accessible name. PACE has aria-describedby 'calculated from distance and duration'; once edited it reads 'manual'. RPE is a radiogroup of 10 with roving tabindex and plain-language anchors ('7 — could speak a sentence'). Sticky header must not cover the focused field (scroll-padding-top). 16px input text prevents iOS zoom.
notes.responsive: Single column on phone. At >=720px the sheet becomes a centred panel with prescription left, form right.

wires.screen: 3. Log sheet — run, filled (the state that ships)

notes.intent: Filled state proves the instrument is working. Pace and the prescribed-vs-actual delta are the two facts that matter, so they are large mono, and the RPE cell shows the plain-language meaning of 7 inline so the scale stops being a vocabulary test.
tokens: ink for the pace readout and the delta line
amber MARK = selected RPE cell edge (▏7▕) and the active unit segment only
--signal-ink for nothing here (no amber text needed)
steel for helper lines and the auto badge
components: SelectedRpeCell (ink fill + amber top edge tick + inert numeric)
DeltaLine (mono, contrasts logged vs prescribed in one sentence)
notes.motion: On blur of duration, the PACE value swaps instantly and a 1px hairline-strong underline fades in/out once (120ms) to say 'recomputed'. No count-up, no odometer. Reduced motion: underline appears without fade.
notes.a11y: The delta is text ('5 seconds slower than the target band'), so being outside the band is never colour-only. Selected RPE cell is aria-checked in the radiogroup; its meaning text appears in the description. Save announces 'Run saved' through the shared polite live region and returns focus to the card's LOG button.
notes.responsive: Delta line wraps under the note below 360px; RPE stays 5-across at 44px because --tap-min forbids a 10-across row on a 390px phone.

wires.screen: 4. Log sheet — strength, 6 machines readable on a phone

notes.intent: Six machines stay readable because five are single lines (name · done/total · target) and exactly one is expanded to its set table. The whole session fits one phone scroll; opening a machine collapses the previous one, so the ledger never grows past one table. This is the M1 strength shell with the logging affordances added.
tokens: --hairline-strong row rules inside the set table
--sunken wells for editable reps/kg cells
amber MARK on completed-set ✓ and the up-load delta triangle only
steel for collapsed machine lines, ink for the active machine name
components: MachineBlock (collapsed row | expanded set table, grid-rows 0fr->1fr)
SetTable (real <table>, caption 'Leg press, target 3 sets of 8 at 80 kilograms')
RepeatLastSet (per-pending-row '↻ same' chip copies the row above; header REPEAT LAST copies all of last week)
notes.motion: Machine expand 180ms grid-rows. Add-set: new row enters 120ms height 0->auto + fade. Repeat fills instantly (numbers swap, no animation). Row complete: 120ms ink flash on the ✓ cell. Reduced motion: instant.
notes.a11y: Real table with row groups; each set row is three labelled inputs ('set 3 reps', 'set 3 kilograms'). Steppers/rt are buttons named 'repeat the values from set 2', not a glyph. Remove-set with entered data opens a confirm dialog and announces 'Set 3 removed, 2 sets remaining'. Live region: 'Set 2 of 3 logged, 80 kilograms for 8 reps'. Weight step 2.5 kg, exposed via aria-valuetext. Never a slider for weight.
notes.responsive: Below 360px the set table drops the SET column and numbers rows on the left edge; collapsed machine lines keep target visible. The expanded machine is scroll-anchored so its header stays under the sticky toolbar.

wires.screen: 5. Log sheet — strength, repeat last set + add/remove in detail

notes.intent: The two gym-speed affordances are explicit and adjacent: '↻ same' on the next pending set (one tap duplicates the last set, which is how almost every set after the first is logged), and '+ SET' to add a row that itself copies the last set's values. RPE sits once per session, not per set, because per-set RPE is a chore mid-workout.
tokens: amber MARK reserved for completion and the load delta; never on buttons
ink-filled stepper wells
mono numerals with slashed zero
components: RemoveSet removes the last row (or a chosen row) with confirm if it has data
notes.motion: Tick draw 90ms stroke-dashoffset; reduced => visible tick immediately. No spinner animation on +SET.
notes.a11y: '↻ same' accessible name is 'repeat set 2, 8 reps at 80 kilograms'; the visible glyph is aria-hidden. Add/remove announce the new set count. The table has scope on its header cells so SR reads 'set, 2; reps, 8; kilograms, 80'.
notes.responsive: Steppers are +/- with hold-to-repeat after 400ms and stay 44x44.

wires.screen: 6. Completed state — session card, shape unchanged

notes.intent: Completion is added, not laid out. The shell keeps its four bands (header / title+target grid / rule / footer). Three signals change: a ✓ mark joins the type zone, the meta line is prefixed 'LOGGED' and now carries actual-vs-prescribed facts, and the footer CTA becomes a filled 'LOGGED ✓ edit' state. The two-column target grid is untouched — no new rows, no new card.
tokens: amber MARK on the ✓ and on the filled modality edge tick
ink-filled 'LOGGED' pill is NOT used; instead the button reads as done via a check glyph + ink text, keeping amber out of the CTA
hairline-strong stays the rule layer
components: MetaLine switches from prescription band text to LoggedLine
EdgeTick gains a filled state (our one shape change: the tick fills, the card outline does not move)
notes.motion: On save, the ✓ draws (90ms stroke) and the edge tick fills top->bottom (160ms); reduced motion: both appear complete. The card does not resize.
notes.a11y: The ✓ is decorative; the state is spoken through the button text 'Logged, edit' and the LoggedLine text. Card aria-labelledby now includes 'logged' so SR users hear completion. The edit action reopens the same sheet pre-filled; no lost data.
notes.responsive: Identical shape at every width; only the target labels ('prescribed/target') remain, so nothing collapses on completion.

wires.screen: 7. Completed state — week strip marks (no card-shape change)
wires.ascii:
M    T    W    T    F    S    S
 18   19   20   21   22   23   24
 ✓    ✓    ✓    ○   ⟨●⟩   ·    ·
───────────────────────────────────
 done ✓      missed ○     today ⟨●⟩
 planned ●   rest ·

 card: one-day row is all that a
 completed day adds to the strip.

notes.intent: The strip is the same 7-cell instrument; completion is a ✓ mark under the initial plus a filled node. Today keeps its ring; a missed past session becomes a hollow node (not red, not a scold). Rest days are a middot.
tokens: amber MARK on the ✓ glyph
ink for the filled node
--hairline-strong for the hollow/today ring stroke
steel for rest middots
components: WeekCell states: done (✓+filled), missed (hollow), today (ring+filled), planned (small filled node), rest (middot)
notes.motion: On save the cell's ✓ draws once (90ms) and the node fills; reduced motion: instant.
notes.a11y: Each cell's accessible name carries state: 'Monday 18 November, completed, intervals 6 km'; 'Tuesday 21 November, missed'; 'Friday 22 November, today'. State is never encoded by shape/colour alone; text names it.
notes.responsive: Cells stay 48px and 7-across; at >=720px a completed cell may also show the logged distance in mono under the initial.

wires.screen: 8. Calendar — week navigation + past/today/upcoming + week so far

notes.intent: Prev/next arrows flank a mono week title; both are 44px and disabled at plan bounds (past weeks are retrospective, future weeks are preview). Past cells use the missed/completed marks, today keeps the ring, upcoming cells are quiet. 'Week so far' now counts logged data: sessions done/planned, and volume is logged km against prescribed target.
tokens: signal MARK on the today ring and the current-week node only
hairline-strong target notch on the volume bar
steel for disabled arrows
mono for all figures and dates
components: AdherenceBar (4 segments, ink fill on paper)
VolumeScale (logged fill + target notch + mono labels)
LoadSparkline (4 weeks, ink bars, no axis)
notes.motion: Week change: 140ms crossfade between weeks (no horizontal slide, matching M1). Bars fill once on first intersection (420ms), then never re-animate even when logged data changes the numbers. Reduced motion: final state.
notes.a11y: Arrows are labelled 'Previous week' / 'Next week'; disabled at bounds, not hidden. The week title is a heading inside an aria-live=polite region so a week change is announced ('Week 5, 18 to 24 November, base'). Volume reads '11.4 of 31.4 kilometres logged, 36 percent'. Bars are aria-hidden decoration behind real numbers; nothing is canvas-only.
notes.responsive: Logging is available on today and past-today weeks only; a future week shows the same layout with LOG disabled and the footer button reading 'Opens on the day'. At >=720px the strip becomes a grid and 'Week so far' sits to the right of the strip.

wires.screen: 9. Units control — km <-> mi, where it lives and how it reads

notes.intent: One global control, surfaced in exactly the two places the user reads or enters distance: the log sheet header (so it is set before typing) and the 'Week so far' header (so the whole week re-reads at once). It writes settings.prefs.units ('metric' | 'imperial'); storage stays metric, units are presentation only. Never a per-entry override — one truth.
tokens: active segment = ink fill, paper text (never amber)
inactive = steel on --sunken
the live example line is mono with tabular figures
components: ExampleLine (shows the current pace in the active unit so the switch is legible in place)
notes.motion: 90ms background step on the active segment (M1 press-step). Every number on screen swaps instantly; no per-number animation.
notes.a11y: role=radiogroup aria-label 'Distance units'; each segment is a radio labelled 'Kilometres' / 'Miles'. On change, a polite live region says 'Showing miles'. Distances and paces carry the unit in their accessible name ('5 minutes 10 per kilometre'), so a bare number is never ambiguous.
notes.responsive: Segments never shrink below 44px; at <360px the example line drops to its own row under the switch.
notes.edge_notes: Weight stays in kg (PF machines, fitness-standard); a lb toggle is deliberately out of scope here and would be a second additive control, not a third segment. Pace derives from the stored metric value (sec per km) and is re-expressed as mm:ss per mile on display, so the engine and logs never hold imperial.

log_sheet.presentation: Bottom sheet on phones (grip + sticky PrescriptionHeader), centred panel at >=720px. Focus trapped; Esc closes; focus returns to the invoking LOG button. Sheet surface is --sunken on --paper with a 2px radius, no drop shadow (a machined plate does not float).

run.derivation: paceSecPerKm = round(durationSec / distanceKm). Shown large in mono immediately under the two inputs. Editing pace flips the badge AUTO -> MANUAL and stops re-deriving. Derived pace never animates (numerals anti-rule).
run.delta_line: One mono sentence contrasts logged vs prescribed: '5s slower than band · 0.02 km over plan'. Outside-band is stated in words, never by colour.
run.empty_vs_filled: Empty: pace shows '— /km' with helper 'distance ÷ duration'. Filled: pace shows the value, the RPE cell shows its plain-language meaning inline, and SAVE enables.
run.entry: SessionCard footer [LOG RUN ▸] -> sheet-rise. Save writes logs.runStats (RunStats type) + rpe + notes, then returns to the card in completed state.

strength.structure: One expanded machine + N collapsed machine lines. Opening a machine closes the previous one, so at most one set table is ever on screen. Persisted per-session as logs.strengthSets (StrengthSet[]).
strength.collapsed_row: name (display) · done/total (mono) · target 3x8·80kg (mono steel). Six rows occupy ~6*44px, so the whole session is one scroll.
strength.set_row: set number · reps (well) · kg (well) · state (✓ mark / '↻ same' chip). Tapping a well opens a numeric keypad; the row above is the default.
strength.repeat_last_set: Two entry points: the per-row '↻ same' chip copies the immediately previous set's reps+kg into the pending row in one tap; the header 'REPEAT LAST ▸' fills every unlogged set of the active machine from last week's stored log. The copy is silent (no praise), numbers swap instantly.
strength.add_remove: + SET appends a row pre-filled from the last set. ─ REMOVE SET removes the last row, or a chosen row, and confirms if that row has data. Both 44px with full-word labels.
strength.scope: 6 machines (defaultCircuit: Leg press, Leg curl, Leg extension, Back extension, Seated row, Shoulder press). One session-level RPE, not per-set.
strength.entry: SessionCard footer [LOG SET ▸] (or [LOG LIFT ▸]) -> sheet. Save writes strengthSets + rpe + notes.

shared.units_control: KM | MI in the sheet header, top-right, right of the title.
shared.save: PrimaryButton ink fill, full width, 48px. Announces through the shared polite live region and returns focus to the card.

completed_state.principle: Add, do not re-lay-out. The M1 shell (header / title + target grid / rule / footer) is byte-for-byte the same; three additive signals mark completion.

session_card.signal_1_mark: A ✓ joins the type zone (amber MARK, 90ms draw).
session_card.signal_2_meta: The meta line is prefixed LOGGED and carries actual-vs-prescribed facts (logged distance · duration · pace, then the delta).
session_card.signal_3_action: The footer CTA changes from [LOG RUN ▸] to [LOGGED ✓ edit]; the modality edge tick fills. No new rows, no new card variant.
session_card.edit: Reopens the log sheet pre-filled from logs.runStats / logs.strengthSets; saving updates the same log row.

cell_states: today = ring + filled node (ring is amber MARK)
week_strip.rule: No red, no shake, no streak copy. A missed session is a shape fact, stated in words in the accessible name.

week_so_far.adherence: done sessions / planned sessions, from logs matched to the week's session ids.
week_so_far.volume: sum(logged distanceKm) vs sum(prescribed targetDistanceKm); the bar fills with logged km and the notch marks the target.
week_so_far.load: 4-week bars switch from prescribed to logged load once a week has ended.

calendar.navigation: ‹ / › arrows flank a mono week title ('W5 · 18–24 NOV · BASE'). 44px, aria-disabled at plan bounds (before plan start / after plan end).
calendar.week_title_a11y: Heading inside aria-live=polite: 'Week 5, 18 to 24 November, base'.
calendar.past: Retrospective: cells show done/missed; the hero card for a past day shows the completed state (or 'missed' with an override affordance to log late).
calendar.today: Amber ring + filled node; hero card is action-enabled (LOG).
calendar.upcoming: Quiet cells (small node/middot); hero card is preview-only, its footer reads 'Opens on the day', LOG disabled.
calendar.week_nav_motion: 140ms crossfade between weeks; never a horizontal slide or parallax.

week_so_far.sessions: N / M with a 4-segment ink bar and a mono percentage.
week_so_far.volume: logged / target km with a target notch (hairline-strong).
week_so_far.load: 4-week ink sparkline, no axis, no draw-in.
week_so_far.includes_logged: Both figures count logs; before any log exists they read prescribed-only and the label stays honest ('0 of 5 sessions, 0.0 of 31.4 km').

calendar.units_control_here: KM | MI in the 'Week so far' header so the whole block re-reads at once.

units_control.not_location: Not a global settings modal, not a per-entry override, not a third nav item. One truth per user.
units_control.storage: settings.prefs.units = 'metric' | 'imperial'. All stored values stay metric (km, sec/km, kg). Conversion happens only at render.
units_control.reads_as: Two segments 'KM' / 'MI'; active = ink fill with paper text; the inactive = steel on sunken. An example line shows the active pace ('5:10 /km' or '8:19 /mi') so the effect is visible in place.
conversion: pace min:sec per mile = (sec/km) * 1.609344 rendered as mm:ss
weights stay kg (lb out of scope)
units_control.a11y: role=radiogroup aria-label 'Distance units'; live region announces 'Showing miles'. Unit label travels inside every accessible name for distance and pace.

motion.name: sheet-rise
motion.trigger: LOG RUN / LOG SET / edit a logged session
motion.spec: translateY 24px->0 + opacity; backdrop 160ms opacity only; drag-to-dismiss 1:1

motion.name: pace-recompute
motion.spec: no numeric animation; a single 1px hairline-strong underline fades in then out once to say 'recomputed'

motion.name: set-complete-tick
motion.spec: amber ✓ draws via stroke-dashoffset; 120ms ink flash on the row's state cell only

motion.name: repeat-fill
motion.spec: none on the numbers (swap instantly); the filled row steps --sunken -> --paper in 90ms

motion.name: add-set
motion.reduced_motion: row appears at full height instantly

motion.name: machine-expand
motion.spec: grid-template-rows 0fr->1fr (same mechanic as why-expand); collapse 140ms no delay

motion.name: card-complete
motion.spec: ✓ draws 90ms; modality edge tick fills top->bottom 160ms; card does not resize

motion.name: press-step
motion.spec: background paper->sunken 90ms; no scale, shadow, or ripple

motion.name: ANTI-RULE: numerals never animate
motion.spec: pace, distance, duration, reps, kg, RPE swap instantly. No count-up, odometer, or digit roll — blurred numerals are unreadable mid-effort, and tabular figures exist precisely to avoid the reflow that tempts animation.

a11y.requirement: 44px floor from --tap-min. RPE is a 2x5 grid of 64x48 (10-across is 32px on a 390px phone and is rejected). Steppers 44x44 with hold-to-repeat after 400ms; sheet handles, nav arrows, chips, add/remove all >=44px.

a11y.topic: Colour is never the only signal
a11y.requirement: Completed = ✓ glyph + text 'logged'; missed = hollow node + the word 'missed'; out-of-band pace = a numeric delta in words; selected RPE = filled cell + aria-checked + inline meaning. A greyscale screenshot stays fully readable.

--signal marks only: completed-set tick, load delta, today ring, modality edge fill, active unit/cell edge. Amber is never text (fails 1.97:1 on paper) and never a CTA fill. Amber text uses --signal-ink (5.3:1 light / 10.7:1 dark). Data-encoding strokes use --hairline-strong (3.12:1 / 4.07:1).

Persistent labels above fields; units inside the accessible name; inputmode=decimal for distance/kg and numeric for reps/HR; 16px input text to stop iOS zoom. Derived pace described via aria-describedby ('calculated from distance and duration' vs 'manual'); never announced per keystroke — announced once on blur. Errors inline + aria-live=polite + aria-invalid, never colour-only. No placeholder-as-label.

Real <table> with a caption naming machine, target sets/reps/weight; header cells scoped; each set row is a group of labelled inputs; steppers/rt are buttons with word labels ('decrease reps', 'repeat set 2'), not glyph-only. Completion announced via one polite region with full sentences. Weight never uses a slider.

Focus is trapped while open; Esc closes; focus returns to the invoking LOG button. scroll-padding-top keeps the focused field clear of the sticky prescription header. The sheet is a dialog with aria-labelledby its title.

Arrows labelled 'Previous week' / 'Next week'; aria-disabled at plan bounds. Week title in an aria-live region so a change is announced. Each day cell's accessible name carries the day, date, state, and session ('Friday 22 November, today, tempo 6 kilometres').
One shared polite live region for: set logged, set added/removed, run saved, units changed, week changed, day-count changes. No assertive interruptions during a workout.

No fixed heights on text; 200% zoom reflows the card and sheet. Below 320px the set table drops the SET column; the pace band degrades to text (its accessible source of truth anyway). Display weight stays >=400 at small sizes.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce kills every transform, draw, stagger, and fill; only 90-120ms opacity/colour steps remain. No confetti, no streak flame, no scroll reveals, no sheet spring.

self_critique.ascii_legend: ═ grip, ✓ amber MARK completion, ○ hollow = missed past, ● filled node = planned/done, ⟨●⟩ today (ring + node), · rest middot, ▏..▕ selected RPE cell edge (amber mark), ▓ ink fill, ░ empty track, ▲ load delta, ↻ same = repeat last set, ⋅ editable well.

templated_defaults_avoided.default: A generic full-screen 'workout logger' with big pill inputs and a gradient save button
templated_defaults_avoided.how: Logging is a sheet that already knows the prescription; wells are --sunken plates on --paper with a 2px radius, the CTA is ink on paper, and there is no gradient.

templated_defaults_avoided.default: iOS-style segmented pill for the unit switch
templated_defaults_avoided.how: The switch is two square-edged segments (4px radius) with an ink active fill and a live example line; it is not a rounded pill and amber never fills it.
Two figures (sessions, volume) and one 4-week sparkline, one hairline each — the M1 decision held; the only change is that the numbers now include logged data.
Reuse the M1 44x44 steppers with hold-to-repeat, or tap-to-type; '↻ same' cuts the common case to one tap instead of forcing repeated spinner presses.
Completion is a ✓ mark, a filled tick, and a factual delta line. No praise copy, no animation on numerals.

risks.risk: A six-machine log sheet still scrolls long enough to feel like a chore at the gym.
risks.mitigation: Collapsed rows are single lines and only one machine expands; '↻ same' and '+ SET' make the common set one tap; session RPE is once, not per set. Kept honest by testing the 6-machine case explicitly (wire 4).

risks.risk: Adding a ✓ and a LOGGED line to the card edges toward a second layout.
risks.mitigation: Strictly additive: same four bands, no new rows; the only shape change is the edge tick filling. Review gate: overlay completed and planned cards and diff the band geometry.

risks.risk: Two surfaces for the units control could drift into two truths.
risks.mitigation: Both write the same settings.prefs.units and render from it; no local component state. One control component, two mount points.

risks.risk: Pace recompute underline reads as a flicker.
risks.mitigation: Single 120ms fade, fires only on blur (not per keystroke), disabled under reduced motion.

rejected.reason: Violates the 44px floor (32px cells on a 390px phone). The 2x5 grid is forced by --tap-min, not by taste.
Per-set/per-machine RPE is friction mid-workout and inflates the log; one session RPE plus the load delta carries the meaning.

rejected.option: Showing logged km in miles by storing imperial
rejected.reason: Bakes units into the engine and logs. Units stay presentation; storage is metric.

rejected.option: A rebuild/override of the M2 card shape
rejected.reason: The established card is the signature; M2 must prove it survives real data, not redraw it.

open_questions: Past-week logging: allow a late entry on a missed day, or keep past strictly read-only with a small '+ log missed' ghost link?
Does the collapsed machine row show done/total as '2/3' or a tiny 3-segment micro-bar sharing the card's tick language?
Should SAVE stay enabled with only distance+duration, or require an RPE so adherence quality is always captured?
